dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Veterans Affairs contracting officers, medical contractors, community care providers, and veterans receiving care or educational benefits.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may not obligate or expend more than $50,000,000 for any contract or agreement under this section unless funds for such agreement have been specifically authorized by law.

dimensions.assessment: Places strict statutory spending caps on individual VA contracts and agreements exceeding $50 million unless authorized or exempted.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may not obligate or expend more than $50,000,000 for any agreement under this chapter unless... funds for such agreement have been specifically authorized by law

dimensions.assessment: Restricts spending authority for large-scale VA contracts over $50 million, shifting approval requirements to Congress unless exemptions apply.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may not obligate or expend more than $50,000,000 for any contract or agreement under this section unless funds for such agreement have been specifically authorized by law.

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple sections of Title 38, United States Code, covering VA personal services, community care, educational benefits administration, and prosthetic procurement.
dimensions.evidence: Section 513 of title 38, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory modification to VA procurement and contracting rules, with specific implementation timelines of one to three years for catalog systems.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall implement-- (1) subsection (c)... not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Total number of existing VA contracts affected by the $50 million threshold
Aggregate financial value of contracts currently exceeding $50 million without specific prior authorization
importance_detail.rationale: Limits the Department of Veterans Affairs from obligating or expending more than $50,000,000 for various contracts, community care agreements, and health care resource sharing unless specifically authorized by law or meeting emergency exemptions.
